body.message:
This is Jameel Pasha from Boonstay Vacation Homes. I wanted to check if you would be open to offering this property for short-term rental.

I currently have a guest looking for a 2-bedroom apartment from **4 October to 4 May**. Please let me know if this is something you would consider, and we can discuss the details and work together.

Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.
